crossRefs.note: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
Saul was told that David had come to Keilah. Saul said, “God has delivered him into my hand; for he is shut in by…
My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in man.
There was a little city, and few men within it; and a great king came against it, besieged it, and built great bulwarks…
Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from Yahweh, and whose deeds are in the dark, and who say, “Who sees us?”…
There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Keilah
people.line: A town in the Shephelah of Judah, rescued by David

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Then David said, “Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul?” Yahweh said, “They will deliver you up.”
translations.bsb: So David asked, “Will the citizens of Keilah surrender me and my men into the hand of Saul?” “They will,” said the LORD.
translations.kjv: Then said David, Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul? And the LORD said, They will deliver thee up.
translations.asv: Then said David, Will the men of Keilah deliver up to me and my men into the hand of Saul? And Jehovah said, They will deliver thee up.
